@if (helpOpen()) {

Overview

The Parameter Manager lets you view, create, and customize parameter type definitions. Parameter types are reusable input definitions that services reference by key.

Default vs Custom

  • Default parameter types ship with the application. All fields are fully editable. Use "Reset to Default" to restore the original definition.
  • Custom parameter types are created by you and stored in localStorage. All fields are fully editable.

Parameter Type Fields

FieldDescription
KeyUnique identifier used by service definitions to reference this parameter type. Use lowercase with underscores (e.g., nurse_unit). Read-only on default types to prevent breaking references.
LabelHuman-readable name shown in forms (e.g., "Nurse Unit").
Input TypeControls the form control rendered: text, number, select (dropdown), datetime, date, time, or hidden.
DescriptionHelp text shown below the input field.
Default ValuePre-populated value when the parameter is used in a service.
PlaceholderPlaceholder text shown in the input when empty.
Allow EmptyWhether an empty string is a valid value (sends ^^ in the CCL parameter string).
UnquotedSend the value without ^caret^ quoting. Used for numeric CCL prompts (i2, i4, f8).

Select Options

When the input type is "Select", you define the dropdown options. Each option has a display label and a value that gets sent to CCL.

DateTime Presets

When the input type is "Date/Time", "Date", or "Time", you can define quick-select presets. Each preset has a label shown on the button and a preset key resolved at runtime (e.g., today_start, now, yesterday_end).

How Parameters Connect to Services

Service definitions reference parameter types by key. When you select a service in the Executor, the parameter form is built by looking up each parameter's type from the library. This means changing a parameter type here affects all services that use it.
